name: Classic Teal (Cambria)
description: A Cambria-serif, single-column engineering resume with a bold title, underlined section headings and dense bulleted achievement lists.
style_summary: Dense and information-rich, this single-column layout uses the Cambria serif family throughout with a large title-styled name line and compact small-caps company headers aligned to right-hand date stamps. Each role opens with a 'Technical Scope:' stack line followed by eight to ten tightly packed achievement bullets, so it favours substance over whitespace. The colour palette is essentially monochrome with subtle heading accents, giving a restrained, technical tone. Best suited to mid-to-senior software engineers who need to show deep, tool-heavy delivery history on one continuous page flow.
